title: Annual report: membership numbers
content:
Larkspur Supply Co. 2025 membership report.

Summary: Membership grew 11% in 2025, to 9,400 members. Rentals grew fastest.

Table: Members and activity by quarter, 2025.
Columns: Quarter, New members, Total members, Rentals, Repairs.
- Q1: 210, 8,680, 1,140, 640
- Q2: 390, 9,070, 2,310, 820
- Q3: 260, 9,330, 2,950, 910
- Q4: 70, 9,400, 980, 730
- Total: 930 new members, 9,400 members, 7,380 rentals, 3,100 repairs

Note under the table: Totals for members are year-end figures.
Download: the full report as PDF (/reports/2025.pdf, 2.4 MB).
